title: Council appoints new Kitchener regional councillor
subtitle: Brief special meeting also added two closed-session topics, covering labour relations and an identifiable individual.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting to fill the vacant Kitchener seat. Council passed By-law 25-008, which appoints Matt Rodrigues as Regional Councillor for Kitchener. The Regional Clerk said staff have started onboarding the incoming councillor. A leave of absence from the City of Kitchener begins March 20, 2025, and the regional appointment takes effect March 21, 2025. For residents, this means Kitchener will again have its full representation at the regional table.

Council also moved into a closed session. Because this was a special meeting, members first suspended the procedural by-law rules {{vote:m1}} so two more topics could be added to the one on the agenda. The closed session then went ahead {{vote:m2}}. The publicly reported purposes were legal advice on an ongoing matter that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, a labour relations matter, and information about an identifiable individual. The minutes record no decisions from the closed session.
The Regional Chair opened by noting that March 15 is the International Day to Combat Islamophobia. The meeting adjourned at 9:05 a.m.

decisions.detail: Council gave the by-law three readings and passed it to fill the vacant Kitchener regional councillor seat by appointment, with the appointment effective March 21, 2025.

debate: The Chair explained that the agenda listed only one closed-session purpose, and that adding two more at a special meeting required a two-thirds vote to suspend the procedural by-law rules.
The Regional Clerk told Council that onboarding of the incoming councillor had begun, and that the timing of the city leave of absence sets the March 21 start date for the regional appointment.
The transcript records no substantive debate on the appointment by-law. Members voted after the clerk's update.
